data.name: Geethavarthini
data.gender_notes: Geethavarthini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Geetha (song) + Varthini (chariot). This name refers to the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and learning. It is believed that the name Geethavarthini bestows the blessings of knowledge and learning upon the child. The name Geethavarthini carries the meaning “Song of the chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Geethavarthini usually hope their child will grow to embody song of the chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Geethavarthini belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Song of the chariot.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Geethavarthini total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Geethavarthini was a renowned Tamil poetess of the Sangam Age, who composed several poems on love, longing and beauty.
historical_references.context: Sangam Age was a period of literary excellence in ancient Tamil Nadu, India.

historical_references.reference: Geethavarthini is also known as Auvaiyar, and her works include 'Agam Puranam', 'Nedunalvadai', 'Perumbanatru' and 'Agananauru', which are part of the Tamil Epic anthology 'Agam'.
historical_references.context: Agam is a collection of ancient Tamil poetry that includes both religious and secular texts.
